result.stdout:
ahmadkimiyaz — scaffold Clean Architecture layers into the current solution.

USAGE:
  ahmadkimiyaz -projectName <Name> [options]

ARGUMENTS / FLAGS:
  -projectName, -p, -n <Name>   Base name for the layers
                                (e.g. Shop -> Shop.Domain, Shop.Application, ...).

OPTIONS:
  -o, --output <dir>            Target directory (default: current).
                                Must contain a .slnx or .sln to add projects to.
  -f, --force                   Overwrite existing layer project folders.
  -h, --help                    Show this help.

EXAMPLE:
  dotnet new sln -n MyApp
  ahmadkimiyaz -projectName MyApp
  dotnet build
